title: OpenDEA Insight Rule
description: The governed mechanism that turns assessment evidence into an AssessmentInsight (CR-AM-08 §6). An InsightRule declares a condition over an evidence channel, the insight it produces, and its confidence contract — making insight generation reproducible: same evidence + same rule version → same insight. Rules never redefine eligibility, cohort, or comparison semantics (frozen CR-AM-06/07 surfaces), and never prescribe actions (CR-AM-08 §9). Phase 2 supports the benchmark_comparisons evidence channel (percentile / rank / score metrics); further channels are additive extensions.

condition.description: The evidence selector: channel + metric + operator + threshold. Evaluated against the subject member's standing in the cited BenchmarkComparison.

evidence.description: Evidence channel the rule reads. Phase 2: benchmark_comparisons only.

metric.description: The standing metric the condition evaluates.

result.description: The insight this rule produces when the condition matches.

interpretation_template.description: Statement template. Placeholders substituted at derivation: {value} (subject metric value), {threshold}, {peer_position}, {median}, {n} (population size).

confidence.description: The rule's confidence contract. The derived insight carries this level UNLESS the evidence fails the contract (e.g. population below minimum_population) — then the derivation downgrades to low with an explicit limitation. Confidence never exceeds what the evidence supports (CR-AM-08 §5).

minimum_population.description: Minimum admitted population size for the declared confidence level to hold.
